core_conclusion.pending_and_ACK: snapshot() is const and does not offer/consume faults. Unoffered, stale-context, stale-generation, duplicate and terminal tickets reject. Stop, time passage, rearm attempts and idempotent context requests do not clear pending. offer_fault()/acknowledge() only enforce the offered version: the trusted owner must prove completed matching invalid control consumption.
core_conclusion.contexts_and_clock: Nonzero increasing contexts invalidate queues and offered tickets; zero/recycled lower context is terminal. Matching active event clocks must be monotonic and captured<=observed with age<=5000us. Foreign/inactive callbacks do not import an untrusted clock. Owner arm/ACK calls apply their global monotonic clock fence even when metadata is stale; time must be sampled inside the common serialization.
core_conclusion.queue_and_sequences: Ring size remains<=64; accepted=dequeued+discarded+queued in30000 mixed randomized lifecycle operations without saturation. Delivered sequence numbers are nonzero and increasing; loss discards the complete queued series without sequence reuse. Last U64 sequence is usable, then exhaustion suppresses terminally without wrapping.
core_conclusion.exhaustion: Reviewer-only private-state seeding exercised otherwise unreachable boundaries. Diagnostic counters saturate without wrapping or consuming faults. Fault generation UINT64_MAX can be offered/ACKed once; the next fault is terminal and pending remains true even if acknowledged_generation equals fault_generation. Context wrap is terminal. Seeding changes access control in the reviewer TU only; project headers were not edited.
core_conclusion.boundaries: 50us minimum spacing and5000us maximum latch age are inclusive. Prearm timestamps at/before arm are ignored but matching active callbacks still consume budget. The32/10ms callback window is fixed and per armed episode; adjacent windows may admit64. It excludes foreign/inactive callbacks and can be restarted by trusted normal stop/arm. Noise retry must use actual suppression plus ACK/50ms holdoff; masked time does not prove electrical quiet.
core_conclusion.stop_rearm: Stop/rearm resets only ingress queue/edge history. It does not invalidate a separate Capture worker. The contract now explicitly requires that invalidation and a fresh complete waveform window. Last-observed retry_holdoff is not a live-time diagnostic age.

future_owner_publication_fence.status: Required but unimplemented, now explicit in the three final documentary files.
future_owner_publication_fence.obligation: Latch context, ingress fault generation and arm boundary with pop under the shared serialization. Processing Capture outside the lock does not authorize publication. Before publish, atomically revalidate current context/generation/armed state and the popped event timestamp against the current arm boundary, then commit under the same lock or equivalent versioned commit. A mismatch discards the result and invalidates/reacquires the separate Capture series.
future_owner_publication_fence.reason: IngressEdge has no fault-generation field. ISR suppression or same-context stop/rearm can occur after pop. The companion snapshot/version must be retained; single floating-point ownership alone does not close this race.
